summary: Re-verified the palm-rejection fix in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx after iteration 7's two action items were applied. Both static-wiring fixes are now in place: (1) onTouchesDown looks up the touch via `allT[0] ?? chgT[0]` (allTouches first, changedTouches fallback) and (2) the strict palm-rejection branch early-returns on BOTH the finger and stylus paths (no neutral fall-through). The permissive `isStylus || (toolType === undefined && pointerType === undefined)` line is now only reachable when palmRejection is OFF. All other iteration-7 wiring (refs, twoFingerPanY, composedGesture, multi-page Skia render, add-page-btn, page-indicator, settings toggle) is unchanged. Web smoke regression PASSED with 0 page errors. NATIVE VERIFICATION ON S25 ULTRA IS STILL REQUIRED — the web preview replaces the Skia canvas with a 'Stylus / S Pen canvas' fallback, so finger-vs-stylus rejection, auto-add-page-on-stroke, and 2-finger vertical pan across multi-page canvases cannot be exercised in the web preview.

action_items: NATIVE-ONLY VERIFICATION REQUIRED — rebuild a native APK on the S25 Ultra and confirm: (a) with Pen only ON, finger touches are completely ignored and produce no strokes (the strict branch now does manager.fail() with no neutral fall-through), (b) with autoAddPage ON, drawing near the bottom of the last page automatically bumps pageCount, (c) two-finger vertical pan scrolls across stacked pages and page-indicator updates. The web preview renders the 'Stylus / S Pen canvas' fallback (draw/[id].tsx:893-902) so none of these can be exercised in the browser.

(Optional, carried over from iter-7) draw/[id].tsx is ~1900 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting toolbar / more-menu modals / gesture handlers / paper rendering into separate modules.

(Optional) The page-indicator current-page formula `Math.floor(scrollY / basePageH) + 1` (draw/[id].tsx:951) doesn't advance when auto-add fires on stroke end. Consider also bumping scrollY in the auto-add branch (draw/[id].tsx:530-535) so the indicator reflects the newly-added page.
critical_code_review_comments: The strict palm-rejection block is now exactly as requested — both branches early-return, so the permissive `isStylus || (toolType === undefined && pointerType === undefined)` line on draw/[id].tsx:486 is only reachable when palmRejectionRef.current is false. This eliminates the regression flagged in iteration 7 where unknown pointer types could leak through with Pen-only ON.
useEffect on [pageCount] (draw/[id].tsx:289-294) still triggers one redundant persist on the first render after load. Harmless but a `hasMounted` ref would avoid it.

The only remaining verification is a NATIVE rebuild on the S25 Ultra: fingers must be rejected with Pen-only ON, auto-add-page must trigger on stroke-end near the bottom, and the 2-finger vertical pan must scroll across multi-page canvases — these cannot be exercised on web because the canvas is replaced with a static fallback message.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: fingers continued to draw with 'Pen only' on. Root causes were (a) settings.palmRejection captured by value at gesture-creation time (fixed in iter 7 with palmRejectionRef.current reads) and (b) the onTouchesDown block had two leaks: it only inspected event.allTouches?.[0] (missing on the first Android MotionEvent) and the strict branch fell through to a neutral `isStylus || unknown` assignment that allowed finger touches to be classified as stylus when toolType/pointerType were missing. The current code (iteration 8 verified) fixes both: it falls back to changedTouches when allTouches is empty, and the strict branch explicitly returns on both the finger (manager.fail()) and stylus paths with no neutral fall-through while palmRejection is on. NATIVE confirmation on the S25 Ultra is still required to close the loop end-to-end because the web fallback canvas prevents simulating finger vs stylus.
